name: Helpless Swan 97
author: lenfear23
description: Rounded white text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks:
On focus, background changes from #e8e8e8 to #e8e8e8, box-shadow becomes inset 5px 5px 17px #c8c8c8,
            inset -5px -5px 17px #ffffff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Helpless Swan 97</title>
<style>
/* Helpless Swan 97 by lenfear23 — https://uiverse.io/lenfear23/helpless-swan-97 */
.input {
  max-width: 200px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 10px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
  outline: none;
  background: #e8e8e8;
  box-shadow: 5px 5px 17px #c8c8c8,
             -5px -5px 17px #ffffff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: all .5s;
}

.input:focus {
  background: #e8e8e8;
  box-shadow: inset 5px 5px 17px #c8c8c8,
            inset -5px -5px 17px #ffffff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="First name" class="input" name="firstName" type="text">

</body>
</html>
